technicalCriterionList.description: I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL or by any State Government/Government of India/ Union Territory. I/we declares that EMD has not been forfeited and None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of default in KPCL or elsewhere during the past 3 (Three) years. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. I/we shall pay fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason.

I/We hereby declare that I/we have carefully studied and understood the nature, scope, importance, urgency, and requirements of the work. I/We have personally inspected the site and familiarized myself/ourselves with the site conditions and all relevant aspects of the work. I/We undertake to take all necessary precautions and adopt appropriate safety measures during the execution of the work. I/We fully understand the emergency and urgency involved and undertake to commence and complete the work without any further delay, strictly within the stipulated time period, without causing any hindrance or compromising the quality of the work. Having understood all the facts, site conditions, and requirements, I/we hereby quote my/our rates for the satisfactory execution and timely completion of the work. The interested bidders/participants must visit the site and get a site visit letter before 22.10.2026 within17:00 Hrs from Chief Engineer (Civil Design) and has to be uploaded in the tender by the Bidders. Otherwise, Bidders are liable for rejection without assigning any reason.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing painting, lighting arrengaments and furnitures at Ground floor of KPCL Building

itemList.description: Removing white or colour wash by scrapping and sand papering and preparing the surface smooth including necessary repairs to scratches etc. complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Repairs to plaster in patches of 2.5 m2 and less in walls, ceilings 10 to 20mm thick in cement mortar 1:4 including cutting the patches in proper shape and replastering the surface of the wall including disposal of rubbish with a lead of 50m including curing cost of materials, labour, complete as per specification.

Dismantling and removing existing electrical switches, socket outlets, switch plates and associated accessories of any type and rating, including safe isolation of the electrical supply, removal of switch plates, modular switches, socket outlets, mounting frames, boxes and associated accessories wherever required, carefully disconnecting the existing wiring without damaging the concealed conduits or surrounding wall finishes. The work shall include sorting and stacking reusable materials at the designated location, disposal of unserviceable debris, making the exposed wiring safe by properly insulating and securing the wire ends, and making good minor damages to the surrounding surface, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. All work shall be carried out by qualified electrical personnel after ensuring the circuit is de-energised and safe.
Feature wall finish: Surface preparation, putty, primer and two coats of premium interior emulsion on walls, excluding feature panelling.
Putty, primer and two coats of premium emulsion to ceiling

French spirit polishing :One coats on old work to give an even surface including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, sand papering smooth , cost of materials, labour co( Flooring)

French spirit polishing :One coats on old work to give an even surface including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, sand papering smooth , cost of materials, labour co (Skirting)
Cove lighting: Concealed aluminium LED profile/strip, approximately 3000K warm white, driver, wiring and installation.
Linear track lighting: Black recessed or surface-mounted track with compatible LED spotlights, connectors andpower feed.
Electrical wiring and accessories: FRLS copper wiring in concealed conduit, junction boxes, switches and connections for lights and desk equipment.
Supplying and installing suspended linear LED conference light with black aluminium housing, diffuser, suspension kit and electrical connection
Executive chair: High-back ergonomic upholstered chair with adjustable seat height, lumbar support, tilt mechanism, armrests and five-star base with castors.

Executive desk: Custom-made premium desk with 18- 25 mm BWR plywood/MDF substrate, walnut wood-grain laminate or veneer finish, powder-coated MS support frame, rounded edges, decorative front fascia and concealed LED strip. Includes fabrication and installation.
